summary.text: Elijah Wilson is the Republican candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Merrimack 18, in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the Republican primary on September 8, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Elijah Wilson ran for Concord City Council Ward 4 in the November 4, 2025 general election, in which Mark Davie defeated him and Jeffrey Tynes.
